mapper.sql: select r.id, r.reader_id, r.book_id, r.dept_id, r.status, r.del_flag, r.create_by, r.create_time, r.update_by, r.update_time, r.remark, i.book_name, i.isbn, i.author, i.cover_image, i.available_stock, rd.real_name as reader_name, rd.card_no, d.dept_name from book_reservation r left join book_info i on r.book_id = i.id left join book_reader rd on r.reader_id = rd.id left join sys_dept d on r.dept_id = d.dept_id
mapper.select: where r.del_flag = '0' and r.reader_id = #{readerId} order by r.create_time desc
select count(1) from book_reservation where reader_id = #{readerId} and book_id = #{bookId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into book_reservation (reader_id, book_id, dept_id, status, del_flag, create_by, create_time) values (#{readerId}, #{bookId}, #{deptId}, #{status}, '0', #{createBy}, #{createTime})
mapper.update: update book_reservation set status = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and reader_id = #{readerId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.select: select count(1) from book_reservation where book_id = #{bookId} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
mapper.update: update book_reservation set status = '3', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update book_reservation set status = '2', update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = now() where id = #{id} and status = '0' and del_flag = '0'
update book_reservation set status = '2', update_by = 'system', update_time = now() where status = '0' and del_flag = '0' and create_time < date_sub(now(), interval #{days} day)
